Data Dictionary

Definitions for the forecast metrics, assumptions, scenarios, validations, and source types used across Foresight.

Governed definitions

Prevalent pool

Population × prevalence rate. The number of people living with the disease in the selected period.

Diagnosed patients

Prevalent or incident patients who have received a confirmed diagnosis, depending on the model entry point.

Treated patients

Diagnosed patients × treatment rate, or a directly entered treated-pool value in treated-pool models.

Clinical eligibility

The share of treated patients meeting product-relevant clinical criteria such as BSA, severity, biomarker, or line of therapy.

Scenario

A coherent alternative future containing assumption changes, events, and a planning thesis. It is separate from a one-way sensitivity.

Event-adjusted forecast

The baseline forecast plus explicitly selected, dated volume, price, access, competitor, or lifecycle events.

Net price

List or gross price after gross-to-net deductions, rebates, payer discounts, and other approved adjustments.

CAGR

Compound annual growth rate: (ending value ÷ starting value)^(1 ÷ number of years) − 1.
